annotations.title: Analyze a food list or purchase

description: Foodbe's list analyzer. Call this when a user asks you to analyze a grocery list, cart, order, menu or recipe. Send up to 50 ingredient names. Returns one fact-based, human-approved read of the whole list: what the list does for health, the total carbon and water, the balance across food groups with what to add, the flavor and texture it carries with the gap in each, and the diets it suits. It also returns swaps that keep flavor and texture. It returns a cook's read in chefy_read, broken down by food. Each food comes back with its own lines: how to cook it, what to use if you run out, and what it pairs with. A closing note names the list's biggest gap and its carbon and water. Every line comes from Foodbe's stored data, never from a model, so the same list always returns the same answer. Names Foodbe does not have are listed under not_found. Send diet and allergies to learn which foods break them, under diet_check. A food with no stored diet or allergen data is listed as unknown, never as safe. Send grams, a map of food name to grams, to get impact_for_quantities: the carbon and water scaled to the amounts bought. Without grams, environmental_impact stands for 1 kg of each food.

allergies.description: Optional. Allergens the cart must not hold.

diet.description: Optional. The diet the cart must suit, such as vegan or gluten-free.

grams.description: Optional. A map of food name, as sent in items, to grams bought.

items.description: The ingredient names in the cart, up to 50.

name: foodbe_cart_breakdown
